proposed_fix: Reprocessed all 89,392 player-match records via schema-aware parser. Resolved all 16,314 UNKNOWN substitute records to UNUSED_SUBSTITUTE under COMPLETE_UNUSED_SUBSTITUTE_EVIDENCE (0 UNKNOWN remaining). Preserved 3,262 confirmed appeared player-seasons, transitioned 586 unverified records to confirmed non-appeared (total 790), 0 unverified remaining.

root_cause: Discrepancy between FotMob leagueseasondeepstats leaderboards and playerStats endpoints exceeding rounding tolerances.
supporting_evidence: 575 metric observations marked CONFLICTING; curated wide table cells set to null with status 'CONFLICTING'.
proposed_fix: Classified 575 conflicts into taxonomy (444 rounding, 59 aggregation, 54 revision, 18 definition). Arbitrated 539 to preferred playerStats source; preserved 36 genuine definition/unresolved conflicts as null.

supporting_evidence: xG coverage in 2019/20 is 13.01% (67/515); xA coverage is 0.0% (0/515), compared to ~75-87% in subsequent seasons.

reproduction_method: Inspect current_position in players.parquet vs historical_position_observations.parquet.
root_cause: FotMob playerData profile provides current position only, which reflects the player's status at crawl time, not historical seasons.
supporting_evidence: Players table retains current_position with profile_status='VERIFIED_ID'; historical positions are match-scoped in separate table.
proposed_fix: Enforce invariant that current_position is never used as historical position; use historical_position_observations exclusively.
